trigger: project-owner hands-on WIP192 Update Rip remained close to fresh-rip wall-clock time

behavior.exact_profile_noop: returns before whole-rip inventory/stat/hash traversal; Verify Rip is the explicit integrity audit
behavior.migration_preflight: component-scoped overwrite guards only; untouched output trees are not globally enumerated
behavior.destructive_guard: verified manifest-bound stat-cache rows are reused when size/mtime/hash still agree; changed-stat or legacy rows are SHA-256 checked before replacement
behavior.retained_bbx_fingerprint: verified OUTPUT_STAT_CACHE + OUTPUT_MANIFEST digest reused for unchanged decompressed_bbx sources; changed-stat/legacy sources are SHA-256 read
behavior.manifest_refresh: untouched rows copied from prior manifest in memory; only changed prefixes and explicit validation paths enumerated and hashed
behavior.stat_cache_refresh: untouched prior cache rows copied in memory; only changed scopes are statted/refreshed
behavior.report_counts: suffix counts projected from old manifest plus changed scopes instead of whole-rip rglob
behavior.privacy_audit: changed component JSON only; prior clean audit reused when no generated JSON scope changed
behavior.final_gate: changed-scope inventory/size/privacy verification; full whole-tree SHA-256 remains Verify Rip
behavior.force_or_recovery: falls back to exhaustive manifest rebuild when old manifest trust is intentionally waived

boundaries: size/mtime cache reuse is optimized for normal user edits; a same-size edit with deliberately preserved mtime requires explicit Verify Rip for detection unless that scope lacks a trusted cache row
actual retail wall-clock improvement must be confirmed by project-owner retest because filesystem/antivirus/storage behavior is environment-specific
component rebuilds that are genuinely invalidated by a converter/viewer/simulator change still take their real generation time
